description:
**Company Description**
Klypup is a digitally native cloud services advisory company that helps organizations accelerate growth and build resilience using AI and AWS expertise. The company focuses on meeting clients where they are on their cloud journey and guiding them toward high-impact solutions. Its services are shaped by customer value, core capabilities, and AWS foundational frameworks. Team members collaborate with innovative businesses and work on modern cloud, AI, and digital transformation projects. To learn more about Klypup’s expertise and offerings, candidates can visit the company website.

**Klypup · Noida (onsite) · Full-time · 1 to 3 years of experience**

**About the role**

At Klypup, our engineers design the screens as they build them. The products work, but

they look like engineers made them.

We're hiring a product designer to change that. You'll own how everything looks and feels,

and you'll work directly with our Founder and CTO.

**What you'll do**

Design features end to end, from rough sketch to final screens

Map user flows and build clickable prototypes, then test them with users

Build our design system from scratch: type, color, spacing, components and motion

Design the empty, loading and error states along with the main flow

Review builds before release and push for fixes when they don't match the design

Suggest features and flow changes to the founders, and make the case for them

**What we're looking for**

1 to 3 years designing web products, ideally B2B software, dashboards or SaaS

A portfolio with case studies that walk through your process, including directions you

tried and dropped

Strong visual design: typography, layout, spacing and hierarchy

Hands-on UX work: user flows, information architecture and usability testing

Experience building or maintaining a design system or component library

Able to work from our Noida office

**Nice to have**

You prototype in Framer, or know enough HTML and CSS to build a rough prototype

yourself

You've shipped work on an AI product, such as a chat interface, an agent dashboard or

a data-heavy tool

You use AI design tools like v0, Google Stitch, Lovable or FramerAI

You've done motion or micro-interaction design

You have side projects you designed on your own

**How we work**

We take ideas to production in days. In a single week you might sketch a feature,

prototype it, sit with engineers during the build, and fix what users struggle with after it

ships.

We use Figma, Framer, v0, Google Stitch, Lovable, Cursor and Claude heavily. They save

time, but you'll be expected to spot bad output.

What you get

You'll own design and the design system for the whole company, with direct mentorship

from the Founder and CTO. Your input shapes the roadmap. There's a path to Design Lead

as the team grows. Pay is competitive.

**How to apply**

Your work matters more to us than your resume. Send us:

1. A link to your portfolio, or a PDF

2. The project you're proudest of, with a few lines on the hardest decision you made in it

3. For team projects, a note on which parts were yours

* If you match most of this listing but not all of it, apply anyway

title: Product Design Intern
description:
🎨
 **Product Design Intern @ Neary 🫟** 




  





 Good design isn't the file you open in Figma first. It's the question you ask before you open Figma at all.
 



  





 Neary is a people\-first app for real\-world connection: no follower counts, no algorithm deciding who deserves your attention. Just proximity, honesty, and every screen we ship having to earn its place. We're looking for a designer who cares as much about
 *why* 
 as
 *what* 
 .
 



  





 This one's for a college student/part\-time consultant, who's hungry to design something real instead of another case study for a portfolio nobody asked for.
 



  





  





**👀 What you'll actually do** 



* Turn fuzzy "what if we..." ideas into flows that actually make sense
* Design in Figma daily, components, auto layout, prototypes people can actually click through
* Build and maintain our design system, themes, tokens, components that don't fall apart the third time someone reuses them
* Iterate fast. Ship a version, get roasted in feedback, fix it properly (not just patch it), move on
* Ask "wait, what problem are we solving here?" before you ask "what should this look like?"
* Keep your files clean. Future\-you, and the engineer picking it up, will thank you
* Sit with engineering and watch your design become a real, tappable thing
* Say "I don't think this is right" out loud, even to us. Especially to us.



  





  





**🛠️ What we hope you bring** 



* Real comfort in Figma, and genuine excitement to get better at it
* An eye for design systems and theming, consistency isn't boring, it's the whole game
* Speed without sloppiness: you iterate quickly and still land on the right fix, not just
 *a* 
 fix
* Product thinking: you notice
 *why* 
 an app feels good to use, not just how it looks
* The instinct to ask good questions before jumping to solutions
* Actual enthusiasm. We can teach skills. We can't teach whether you care.
* A team\-player streak, you take feedback without flinching, and give it kindly too
* Currently in college, third year preferred 🎓



  





  





**📌 The details** 



* Mode: Remote
* Hours: no more than 4 hours a day. This is exactly why college students fit best here, build alongside your semester, not instead of it
* When: no fixed hours. Work whenever you're in flow, mornings, midnights, whenever
* Duration: 8 weeks, extendable for the right person 🐥
* Team: a chill, young crew of 10\+, no hierarchy theatre, just people building
* Team meetups: once a month, entirely optional, snacks non\-negotiable 🥴



  





  





**🎁 What you'll walk away with** 



* Internship Certificate \+ Letter of Recommendation
* Real screens, shipped to real users, not filed away in a design system nobody opens
* Direct mentorship, not a "watch this Loom later" kind
* A portfolio piece with an actual story: the problem, the questions you asked, the thing you shipped



  





  





**💚 Who thrives here** 




 You get a small thrill from a clean file and a cleaner flow. You'd rather ask an awkward question in a meeting than guess quietly and be wrong later. You move fast, fix things right, and care about your team as much as your craft.

* Track and communicate the impact of what ships; deliver outcome, not just the output.


 Engineering Quality
   

  

* Write and review technical requirements and acceptance criteria that leave no ambiguity at implementation time.
* Assess feasibility early and frame build\-vs\-integrate trade\-offs in terms of delivery impact, risk, and value — enabling informed decisions across product and engineering.
* Be the last line of defense on quality: review and test deliverables against requirements, run validation, and hold the bar.
* Identify and highlight technical debt and systemic risks before they become delivery blockers.
* Keep system documentation live and accurate — treated as a product asset, not an afterthought.


 AI\-Enabled Development
   

  

* Use AI tools (Copilot, Claude, and others) fluently as part of your everyday working routines.
* Critically evaluate AI\-generated artifacts — verify correctness and architectural fit before accepting.
* Guide your team on responsible AI usage: when to trust it, when to override it, and how to review it carefully
* Identify where AI can accelerate prototyping cycles and reduce low\-value work in the team.


 Team Agile Practices
   

  

* Maintain a healthy, prioritized product backlog — each item sized, scoped, and ready for the team.
* Work closely with software engineers during implementation — unblock, review, and course\-correct in real time
* Be the connective tissue between stakeholders and the delivery team: clear in both directions.

* Demonstrated ability to move from problem statement to working prototype quickly.
* Experience writing precise technical requirements and acceptance criteria.

* Regular use of AI coding assistants (Copilot, Claude, or equivalent) in a professional context.
* Demonstrated critical evaluation of AI\-generated outputs — not just accepting but interrogating them.

description:
**About the company** 

 :
 




 SiteRecon
 
 is helping enterprise customers in the US to scale their sales teams by automating a key part of the process. We are working with property maintenance contractors and automating property mapping and site visits through our platform, giving back time, speeding up their sales process, and increasing their profitability. 
 





 We are building the next\-generation property intelligence platform and looking for people to help out on our mission to revolutionize how contractor businesses make decisions in North America.

We have improved the time taken for a key process from days to hours, now we are building a team to complete the process within minutes using deep learning.
 




**Job description:** 




  






 SiteRecon is looking for a
 
**Sr. Product designer** 

 who is ready to play a technical role while working directly with the founder of the company. Under this role, you will be responsible for
 
**enhancing customer experience by improving the usability \& accessibility of the products.**

1. Take high level product ideas from conception through execution, across web and mobile.
 
**We are a small team so you'll work across a wide range of areas \- product strategy, user research, and UX/UI design in particular.**
2. Take joint ownership of metrics and strategy with the product team, and
 
**work collaboratively with engineering and operations to achieve goals** 

 .
3. Set a standard for User Experience which matches the likes of Apple Inc., Airbnb and if possible surpasses it.
 
**Simplicity and minimalism are the words to live by** 

 in our product team.

**detailed customer personas** 

 which will drive our design system and methodology

**customer research, user psychology, UX principles and trends and data** 

 (if available).

9. Ability to use analytics tools such as hotjar, Google Analytics, Amplitude and survey tools to understand the engagement of users with the live product and improve designs to boost the product KPIs
10. Working closely with the product development team to deliver best in class
 
**feasible** 

 designs over different versions.
11. Do product testing as a part of UAT before every release to ensure
 
**pixel perfect** 

 delivery, check whether the actual data is not contradicting with the proposed design and the user flows are as easy and complete as imagined during design.
12. Planning concepts for design assets by studying relevant information and materials related to geospatial, AI agents and SiteRecon.
13. Illustrating concepts by designing digital assets for social media, blog and other channels with attention to visual aesthetic, art arrangement, size, type, color layout as per branding practices, size and style.



  





**Required skills \& qualifications:** 




  




1. Bachelor's / Master's degree in design, HCI or equivalent professional experience.
2. At least 5 years of work experience in Product UX design along with at least 2 years experience in conducting user research through interviews,heatmaps and surveys.
3. Entrepreneurship or small startup experience
4. Proficient in design tools like \-
5. Figma
6. Adobe Photoshop/ Illustrator
7. Good knowledge of HTML 5/ CSS3  and CSS frameworks to check for design bugs during release testing
8. Experience with working with usability research tools.
9. An Aptitude \& honed intuition for tasteful visual design details.
10. Ability to research trends in the market for a seamless user experience.
11. A strong awareness of common usability methods \& principles.
12. Excellent communication, presentation, interpersonal \& analytical skills
13. Ability to work methodically \& meet deadlines.



  





**Values that we admire:** 




  




1. **Bias for Action** 

 \- We practice high\-velocity decision\-making, despite encountering ambiguity frequently.
2. **Act Like an Owner** 

 \- We have a strong ownership mentality, because of this, we work smart, hard, and long. Every person on the team has the potential to have a large impact.
3. **Always Be Learning** 

 \- We learn rapidly and eagerly, from different teams within and outside the company. Respectful debate makes our organization stronger.
4. **Empathy, Trust, Candor \-** 

 Being empathetic to our users and each other helps build trust in our community and company and fosters successful decision\-making.
